statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the single line item 'Depreciation and amortization' in the operating activities section of the cash flow statement. The supplementary tables contain detailed lease information (Note 18) and parent company cash flows (Note 33), but these do not provide additional components that make up the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure reported in the primary statement. Therefore, only the primary statement line item is used.
